name: Peak near Shackleton (Site07, largest RoI)
site_definition: centroid of the largest PGDA RoI of the site (data/derived/rois.json, docs/knowledge/sites.md)
height_reference: radial height above the sphere R_m (LOLA heights)
az_convention: 0 = local North, 90 = East (clockwise); horizontal plane perpendicular to the radial vertical
az_wrap: 7200 unique directions 0..359.95; no duplicate 360; periodic when interpolating

coverage.bounds_source: global LOLA extremes -9129 / +10792 m (Smith et al. 2017, Icarus 283, 70-91) + 100 m margin; DEM extremes are -9127.11 (240 m) / +7026.33 (80 m)

sampling.peak_refinement: 8 highest local maxima per ray re-sampled at step/10 over +-1 step, then the best point at step/100 over +-step/10

method: max terrain elevation angle along great circles, exact curvature (Zarina README 8.3), bilinear, finest valid DEM blended across seams
